The house

      

        
floor
a layer of the DBMS: queries, store, persistence; the application works on the roof

        
robot
a component at work

        
paper
a call, carried down the stairs by hand

        
rack
a key-value store: a slot is a key, its parcel the value

        
green tag
a copy on its way up: a result, in the lift

        
bar chart
an aggregate: built from many rows, which stay below

        
q1
the name of a prepared plan, which the DBMS keeps

        
VIP ticket
a prepared query: its plan made once (PREPARE), the key filled in (EXECUTE)

      

      
The design of slides 10–13. Not all of it is in system/ yet: the query
        optimizer and the execution of plans (only partly, in the notebooks); (1a.) waits behind its cage, as the
        store does not persist yet. (1b.) stays empty: these orders need no intermediate results. The rows are an
        invented example. In system/, a prepared query's name is a number (the first is 0), and the optimizer
        fills its parameter in (bind_parameters); here the reception does it.
